metadata.title: Secure-Device IoT SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing Internet of Things (IoT) devices with limited assurance, external management, or reduced visibility.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits Secure-Device Platform trust semantics and applies conservative trust constraints appropriate for IoT devices.

system-characteristics.system-description: IoT devices include commodity, consumer-grade, externally managed, or purpose-built devices that execute instructions but may lack strong integrity or lifecycle guarantees. This SSPP assumes minimal inherent trust and emphasizes containment, attribution, and revocation.

props.name: device-class
props.remarks: Applies to commodity and non-safety-critical IoT devices.

props.name: trust-assumption
props.remarks: IoT devices are treated as minimally trusted by default.

props.name: authoritative-standard
props.remarks: Defines the authoritative baseline capabilities for IoT devices.

props.name: supporting-guidance
props.remarks: Provides interpretive guidance for applying IoT security capabilities.

props.name: implicit-authorization
props.remarks: IoT device connectivity or telemetry must not imply authorization or operational trust.

props.name: lifecycle-bias
props.remarks: IoT devices are preferentially replaced rather than deeply remediated when trust degrades.

props.name: fail-behavior
props.remarks: IoT devices should default to isolation when integrity or lifecycle signals degrade.

system-implementation.remarks: IoT devices operate under constrained trust assumptions and are governed primarily through segmentation, telemetry attribution, and rapid revocation. This SSPP does not assume device updateability or vendor responsiveness.

roles.title: IoT Security Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines IoT trust constraints, segmentation requirements, and lifecycle limitations.

roles.title: IoT Governance
roles.remarks: Approves IoT device onboarding, acceptable risk levels, and replacement criteria.

roles.title: IoT Operations
roles.remarks: Operates IoT devices under constrained trust, limited change tolerance, and high replacement bias.

roles.title: IoT Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors IoT telemetry, integrity degradation, abnormal behavior, and revocation triggers.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls are satisfied through alignment with NIST IR 8425 baseline capabilities and conservative interpretation of Secure-Device trust signals. This SSPP does not introduce additional control catalogs.
